role: Original inactive scientific author findings and concrete bounded proposals; no independent D/A/source acceptance

sourceScope.remainingCountriesAndOperators: Exact current mapped rows and all explicit partner obligations are supplied for independent bounded source reading. This author does not assert complete sixteen-state coverage or clear every alias.

bilingualCorrectionProposals.before: The learner can derive oxidation numbers for atoms in compounds and balance redox equations using oxidation numbers.
bilingualCorrectionProposals.proposed: The learner can derive oxidation numbers for atoms in inorganic and organic particles, identify redox reactions, and balance redox equations using oxidation numbers.
bilingualCorrectionProposals.reason: Matches all three explicit German clauses without donating experiment, mechanism or thermodynamic competencies.

bilingualCorrectionProposals.before: The learner can calculate amounts of substance, concentrations, and pH values of strong acids and bases and check measurement results for plausibility.
bilingualCorrectionProposals.proposed: The learner can calculate amounts of substance, molar concentrations, and pH values for strong acids and bases, prepare acidic or alkaline solutions of a specified molar concentration, and check measurements for plausibility.
bilingualCorrectionProposals.reason: Restores the German actual preparation operator. Feasible supervised assessment channels are authored; this is no actual execution claim.

atomicityAndScopeProposals.descriptionProposalDe: Die lernende Person kann die bevorzugte Reaktionsrichtung von Protolysen durch den Vergleich korrespondierender Säure-Base-Paare begründen und die Aussagegrenzen des Brønsted-Modells erläutern.
atomicityAndScopeProposals.descriptionProposalEn: The learner can justify the favored direction of proton-transfer reactions by comparing conjugate acid-base pairs and explain the limits of the Brønsted model.
atomicityAndScopeProposals.sourceApplicabilityReason: Current normal source projection has only HB SekII GK/LK for this goal. Sixteen-state canonical applicability is not sixteen direct source witnesses.
atomicityAndScopeProposals.dependencyReviewRequiredForNumericStreng: Current goal48115 covers pK/strength comparison and may be a didactic prerequisite; a proposed requires edit needs graph/source/tuple review before adoption.

atomicityAndScopeProposals.question: Does the quantified solution preparation and pH/plausibility evaluation form one assessable end-to-end routine beyond the existing preparation prerequisite1351706, or does the retained current scope require a reviewed split?

scientificFindings.finding: German explicitly covers inorganic and organic particles plus identification of redox reactions; current English omits both explicit objects and the identification operator.
scientificFindings.resolutionProposal: Separate bounded English wording above; keep German and current valid image.

scientificFindings.finding: German explicitly requires preparing defined acidic/basic solutions; current English omits preparation. A written calculation or supplied measurement is not observed preparation.
scientificFindings.resolutionProposal: Separate bounded English wording above, plus feasible explicitly assessed laboratory channel. Whole-goal atomicity must be decided independently.

scientificFindings.finding: Actual primary PDF p20 contains the E-phase redox block including formulation of reactions and half-equations. PDF p21 starts 3.3 qualitative-phase introduction. Current extraction/mapped locator 3.2-E-REDOX p21 is wrong.
scientificFindings.resolutionProposal: Bounded locator correction in an additive successor source extraction/mapping with independent primary-source check; do not claim live source repaired.

scientificFindings.finding: Actual p23 places complete-protolysis pH calculation in ordinary content; incomplete-protolysis pH calculation is explicitly in LK. The extraction merges strong/weak acids/bases. f1ed covers strong solutions only and cannot supply the whole weak-solution clause.
scientificFindings.resolutionProposal: Retain complete-protolysis clause for f1ed only; preserve separate weak-protolysis/correct LK operator in existing partner330348, with a reviewed additive source split if required. Whole source row is not full f1ed evidence.

scientificFindings.finding: HE E.2 combines pH definition, actual indicator detection and strong-solution pH calculation; another row requires Brønsted ionic protolysis equations. Current f1ed-only mappings do not by themselves allocate all those operators to the goal that actually owns them.

existingPartnerCandidates.role: Already current reviewed controlled indicator/pH-range distinction competence; practical detection must retain actual performance.
Current Brønsted concept, equations and pairs; source ionic-equation clause belongs to its actual competence.

scientificFindings.resolutionProposal: Independently review a clause-specific mapping successor linking actual existing partner goals. Retain current strong-solution calculation core; no silently discarded indicator or ionic-equation obligation.

scientificFindings.finding: The title compares acid-base pairs, while the description combines equilibrium-direction judgment, actual indicator detection and model reflection. Only one current direct source witness exists, the HB p23 strength/equilibrium clause, shared with pK goal48115. It does not directly ground the complete actual-detection operator.
scientificFindings.resolutionProposal: Review separation into the stable pair-direction/model-limit core and existing controlled indicator competence d2ccd. No new ID needed for the already existing indicator competence. Source scope should be explicitly HB only unless additional actual direct witnesses are reviewed.

scientificFindings.finding: The actually read NW primary clause classifies proton donors as acids and proton acceptors as bases; it has no oxidation-number operation. Yet the selected current mapping directly targets redox496 among many partners. Additional exact current pure-protolysis rows in MV/RP/SL/SN are suspect aliases; they have not all received a new primary-source scientific vote.
scientificFindings.resolutionProposal: Do not treat donor/acceptor wording as oxidation evidence automatically. Targeted reviewed mapping pruning must preserve actual acid/base partner obligations. Prescreen is a queue, not a scientific batch approval.

practicalPerformanceBoundary: A feasible actual execution channel is part of an authored assessment specification. No real teacher/class execution is required to author machine curriculum QA; supplied fictional measurements and model answers never prove actual learner performance, Human Approval, or Human Trial.
